title: Chapter 94
text:
The mercenaries of Rose Militant staggered toward the direction where the bullets came from. They were all corroded by the poisonous gas and were poisoned. Only Dorothy, who had the physique of a Pugilist, managed to hold on and lead the way.

Han Xiao did not panic. He switched to the shuttle-shaped bullets and fired one shot after another. The gunshots seemed to have a steady rhythm as he killed the mercenaries of Rose Militant one by one. The bulletproof vests could not withstand the penetrative power of the shuttle-shaped bullets. With his various skills, he could deal more than 130 points of theoretical damage with each shot. These ordinary mercenaries were around Level 5 to Level 8 and had around 150 HP. One shot was enough to kill them. Coupled with the bleeding, burning, and poisonous gas, there was no need for him to fire a second shot. His killing efficiency was extremely high.

He purposely left Dorothy for last so that he could eliminate Dorothy's helpers first and deal with the strongest one alone.

After killing the last ordinary mercenary, Dorothy finally reached him. She raised the modified submachine gun in her hand and fired wildly at him.

Han Xiao ducked his head, and all the bullets landed on the sand dune, splashing sand everywhere.

Dorothy ran and fired at the same time. When she ran out of bullets, she finally reached Han Xiao. A cruel expression appeared on her face.

When a Pugilist closed in on a Sniper, only death awaited him!

Dorothy could not wait to smash Han Xiao's skull into pieces, just like she had done dozens of times to others.

"Tiger Hunting Axe!"

Dorothy swung her elbow horizontally like a huge axe. With a whoosh, she rushed toward Han Xiao's head. She felt that this elbow could definitely smash Han Xiao's brains out.

The fierce elbow missed, and Han Xiao suddenly slid back three meters like a loach.

"Slide Shooting!"

Han Xiao pulled out the two Berserk Eagles from behind his waist. With the support of Overload and Continuous Shooting, seven to eight shuttle-shaped bullets were shot into Dorothy's body in an instant.

Dorothy screamed in pain, but her eyes were filled with arrogance. She pulled out a shotgun from her back and shot a shower of bullets at Han Xiao.

"The shotgun can do the most damage at this distance. No matter who you are, you're dead meat!"

The thought flashed through Dorothy's mind, but in the next moment, she was shocked by the scene before her eyes.

The scale-like armor instantly covered Han Xiao's upper body. Sparks burst out when the shrapnel hit the armor. With his current technology, he could already make a magnetic controlled armor that covered half of his body, and the surface area was even larger.

Are you stupid? I have armor!

In the next moment, Han Xiao shot all the bullets in the clip into Dorothy's body. Only Pan Kuang, a martial artist, could barely withstand bullets with his body. Dorothy was far from being able to withstand the power of the large-caliber bullets. Blood spurted out of her mouth as she fell to the ground. She stared at Han Xiao with bloodshot eyes. Her lips moved as if she wanted to say something.

Bang! Han Xiao directly shattered this black girl's head with a single shot.

It was common knowledge that snipers were weak in close combat. Pan Kuang used to think so too, but he died.

You have killed Dorothy (LV25). You have received 7,500 EXP.

In the early stages of the game, snipers had long-range suppressive abilities. It was very convenient for them to kill monsters. However, only the big guilds would nurture them because the cost of a sniper was too high. Even the worst sniper rifle cost tens of thousands of EXP. Every bullet was expensive. Furthermore, normal snipers did not have Han Xiao's magnetic controlled retractable armor. Once they were in close combat, they would be beaten to a pulp.

Han Xiao flipped Dorothy's body and found that the gun Dorothy used had traces of modification. From the way it was used, Rose Militant should have a skilled mechanic.

After killing this group of enemies, he received more than 10,000 EXP. The flames of the Poison Deflagration Incendiary Bullets did not stop for a long time. It would not take long before enemies were attracted.

He retracted the EMP Jammer. He returned to the car and drove away.

Not long after he left, a group of Gaton mercenaries arrived at the scene. They were shocked when they saw the scene.

"They are from Rose Militant."

"Who ambushed them?"

Just as the Gaton mercenaries were about to get out of the car to check, Luo Qing arrived at the scene with a small armed team. She saw the tragic deaths of her comrades and the Gaton mercenaries at the scene.

"Open fire!"

Both parties had been in conflict for a long time. When enemies met, their eyes burned with hatred. It was impossible to explain. They had to fight first.

Luo Qing did not hesitate. She ordered the attack, and the Gaton mercenaries retaliated immediately. An intense battle broke out, and gunshots and explosions resounded in the night sky.

Very soon, the other forces were attracted to the scene. When they saw the intense battle between Rose Militant and the Gaton mercenaries, they wanted to be the oriole and immediately joined in. The scene turned into a chaotic battle.

After fighting for a while, a few armed groups that were further away arrived at the scene. Before they knew what was going on, they saw that everyone was fighting. If they did not join in the fun, they would be no different from idlers. They happily joined in and joined in.

After fighting for half the night, all the groups had suffered losses. They retreated and licked their wounds. The last few forces that arrived had even forgotten why they were fighting and left immediately.

Rose Militant brought back twenty corpses. Most of the corpses only had one fatal wound from a sniper bullet.

"Looks like the one who ambushed Dorothy was not a Gaton. It was a sniper," Ghostly Fox said.

Luo Qing's face was gloomy. She was secretly thinking about who could have ambushed them. Rose Militant's enemies were all in the Somar Desert. If there was a battle, it should be a head-on confrontation. This kind of ambush reminded her of two years ago, when the Rothschild Family had just issued a bounty for them. Many assassins had come alone to deal with Rose Militant.

"Another assassin who accepted the bounty?" Luo Qing frowned. Rose Militant had not been harassed by an assassin for more than a year.

After more than a year, would there be another idiot who had forgotten the lesson of the past?

Dorothy's death was tragic. She seemed to have been shot at close range. This meant that the sniper this time had a certain level of close-range combat ability.

A petite woman wearing an oil stained coat walked over. She said softly, "I found the tracks where the assassin left. He went southeast. There are three forces in that direction. The nearest one is the Farian Group's stronghold."

"Thank you for your hard work, Su Li."

Su Li was a mechanic in Rose Militant. She was in charge of the maintenance and modification of guns, vehicles, and defense facilities.

"I found fragments of a landmine explosion at the scene. This was a premeditated trap. The shell of the landmine was made by the Farian Group. The assassin might have landed in the Farian Group's stronghold. I tried to reconstruct the structure of the landmine. It seems to be a new type of bomb that has never been seen before. The explosion should be related to gas. "

Luo Qing squinted her eyes. The assassin this time was not easy to deal with, but she was not worried. She dialed an encrypted number to contact the sponsor.

"Mr. Sebastian, an assassin is hunting us. We have lost a twenty-man team."

An old and hoarse voice came from the phone. "I will send someone to deal with it."

Every time an assassin appeared, the sponsor would send 'professionals' to deal with the assassin. This was the reason why Rose Militant buried so many assassins in the Somar Desert.

Professionals who dealt with assassins were still assassins.

PS: Thank you very much for the bounty. Thank you, brother!
